items.summary: Alexander Isak scored twice in the opening nine minutes as Liverpool secured their first Premier League win under Andoni Iraola, defeating Ipswich Town 2-0 at Portman Road with Cody Gakpo assisting both goals.

items.summary: Record signing Bradley Barcola made his Liverpool debut off the bench against Ipswich, recording the fastest speed in the Premier League this season at 35.9 km/h during his 26-minute cameo.

source.title: Bradley Barcola Makes Immediate Liverpool Impact With League-Leading Statistic
